signals.label: Age-based flattery
signals.description: Flattery that frames a younger participant as unusually mature.

signals.label: Manufactured trust
signals.description: Language encouraging privileged or exclusive disclosure.
phrases: tell me things you cannot tell

signals.label: Secrecy request
signals.description: A request to conceal the relationship, conversation, or activity.

signals.label: Parental isolation
signals.description: Language discouraging disclosure to a parent or guardian.
phrases: no need to mention me to your parents

signals.label: Social isolation
signals.description: Language that undermines the participant's existing social support.
phrases: your friends do not understand you

signals.label: Exclusive dependency
signals.description: Language positioning one person as the participant's only trusted support.
phrases: i am the only one you can trust

signals.label: Emotional manipulation
signals.description: Pressure that frames other relationships as a threat to the conversation.
phrases: do not let them ruin this

signals.label: Platform migration
signals.description: An attempt to move contact to another or less visible platform.

signals.label: Rule circumvention
signals.description: Instructions to bypass household or platform restrictions.

signals.label: Detection evasion
signals.description: Instructions intended to conceal evidence or notifications.
